verdict.description: Approve is valid only when policy_ok and tests_ok are true and material_findings is empty. Reject whenever any blocking issue remains.

summary.description: Concise decision summary. Record non-blocking caveats, style notes, dependency curiosities, and suggestions here rather than in material_findings.

material_findings.description: Blocking issues only. Every entry must justify verdict=reject. This array must be empty when verdict=approve.
